gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-gafata: Refined letterforms with generous tracking lead the way in Stentiga, its crossbars as heavy as its stems. Gafata follows in a contemporary, professional voice, its wide-eyed lowercase e keeping a long page of text easy to move through.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-georama: Approachable Georama sets the tone for the body, its bracelet-like c opened wide, while Stentiga above feels refined and luxurious. And that is the pair's best trick: full-width strokes up top, low capitals below, nothing fussy anywhere.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-gidole: Gidole reads clean and neutral, with terminals that stay apart like open scissor blades and a high-set midline. Stentiga, by contrast, does its best work spread out and luxurious as a display face, while Gidole handles the everyday text.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-heebo: Spaced-out and polished, Stentiga draws its crossbars as thick as its stems, with no thick-thin swing at all. Heebo's curves stop short instead of closing.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-hind-mysuru: Refined Stentiga spreads its tracking wide, crossbars as thick as stems, while Hind Mysuru presses its lowercase tops close to the ascender height. Stentiga earns its keep big and brief.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-hind-vadodara: Professional and clean, Hind Vadodara keeps one thickness in every direction. Next to it, Stentiga feels refined and luxurious, its spread-out tracking and door-ajar openings giving the pair a spacious, unhurried feel.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-karla: Stocky and friendly body, luxurious spaced-out heading. Karla fills its middle band so fully that the line looks sturdy, and a larger Stentiga above it would let those constant-ink strokes show.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-kedebideri: Spread-out, refined, and traced by a constant-width outline: that is Stentiga. Kedebideri rises with a skyward x-height and rounded shapes that stay open, giving the heading a friendly neighbor underneath.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-kufam: Stentiga is at its best as a luxurious display face, tracking opened wide and crossbars as thick as stems. Kufam does the quieter work, its single neon-tube track width and generous curves in e carrying the text.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-lexend: Wide-open and friendly, with outsized lowercase proportions. Lexend keeps its curved strokes open and its thickness steady, so paragraphs under Stentiga's refined, luxurious heading would move along without a snag.
